site.description: Check delays, cancellations and statistics for trains travelling through Extremadura.
footer.description: Open data to follow rail punctuality in Extremadura.
common.noData: There is no data available for this period yet.
today.title: How Extremadura trains are running today
today.description: See the highest known delay for every service travelling through the region. The table refreshes from Renfe's public archive.
today.noLive: The source has not published data for today yet.
week.title: Weekly summary
week.description: Choose a week to see its daily trend, delays and cancellations.
month.title: Monthly summary
month.description: Choose a month to review its services and delay trend.
statistics.title: Punctuality statistics
statistics.description: Compare delays, cancellations and the routes with the most incidents in the available period.
trains.title: All trains from the latest available day
trains.description: Each row gathers a service’s samples and shows its highest recorded delay.
stations.title: Stations with most observed trains
stations.description: Count of recorded services that pass through each Extremadura station.
methodology.title: Where the data comes from
methodology.description: ExtreTren is a static tool: it neither collects personal data nor runs its own backend.
methodology.static.title: Timetable and route
methodology.static.text: We use Renfe's GTFS to identify services and the Extremadura stations each train serves.
methodology.history.title: Delay history
methodology.history.text: The open josernalist/renfe-gtfsrt archive captures Renfe's GTFS-Realtime feed every five minutes.
methodology.filter.title: Reduced copy
methodology.filter.text: Every day we keep only services that call at Extremadura stations and summarise them, keeping the website lightweight.
methodology.live.title: Today page
methodology.live.text: Today downloads the raw CSV directly for the current date; if unavailable, it uses the latest copy bundled with the site.
table.empty: No services were found for this day.
journey.title: History for train
journey.description: Observed delay history for this commercial train number across the available period.
journeyDay.title: Journey for train
journeyDay.description: Every saved observation for this train on the selected day.
journeyDay.timelineDescription: Each row is an observation published by Renfe's feed, in UTC.
day.title: Trains on
day.description: See every observed service, its route and the highest delay recorded on this day.
notFound.title: Page not found
